title: Nori and the Little Round Window
synopsis: Nori visits Mira to admire the round window; three familiar pebbles become imaginary mountains and a quiet humming tune finds its ending.
continuity_state: Before: The castle bakery sits beside Mira's round window. Mira still owns the yellow-star cushion, and Nori keeps exactly three pebbles in her violet pouch, including the striped gray one. After: Nori and Mira meet at Round Window Cottage. With permission, Nori temporarily arranges three pebbles on a cloth as pretend mountains, then returns all three to her violet pouch. Mira keeps her cushion; the castle bakery stays inside the cottage. Nori and Mira discover a shared taste for a soft song ending. Nori goes home near Round Pond with her grown-up.
